solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Host welcoming English man with his peculiar device

indicators.note: a host welcoming a guest takes them inside, so the letter goes within the host's letters
peculiar means odd or out of the ordinary, so the preceding words come out in a strange order

blocks.note: MC, master of ceremonies, is the host of an event
standard abbreviation for English
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A host lets in an Englishman who carries some odd contraption of his own.
explanation.walkthrough: MC takes in E to make MEC, and MAN plus HIS rearranged supply the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanism is a piece of machinery or contrivance, which is what a device is.

clue.text: Become expert in microwave device, having invested time

indicators.note: money invested is put into something, so the device holds the extra letter inside it

blocks.note: a maser is the microwave counterpart of a laser
T is the standard abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Someone learns to work a microwave properly after putting in the hours.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'microwave device' is not a kitchen oven but a MASER (Microwave Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation); T goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To master a skill is to acquire complete knowledge or command of it.

clue.text: Parody of East German leaving Central American country somehow true

indicators.note: something leaving goes away, so those letters are taken out of the country's name
somehow suggests things arranged in some unspecified way, so the following word is rearranged

blocks.note: Costa Rica lies in Central America
Ost is the German word for east
taken as written

explanation.surface: A spoof involving an East German departing from a Latin American state, oddly accurate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'East German' looks like a person from the old GDR, but it is the German word for east, OST, removed from COSTA RICA to leave CARICA.
explanation.definitionFit: A caricature is an exaggerated, mocking imitation, which is the essence of parody.

clue.text: Fruit drink company’s rise covered by a volume

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means reading from the bottom up, so the drink company is read backwards
in a down entry, being covered by something means sitting underneath it, so the other letters come first

blocks.note: taken as written
V is the abbreviation for volume
soda is a fizzy drink
Co is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A soft-drinks firm's growth is reported in a published volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Avocados are the pear-shaped green fruit of a tropical tree.

clue.text: Still turn up, very lost

indicators.note: something lost is gone, so that letter is dropped from the word

blocks.note: to turn something upside down is to invert it
V is the abbreviation for very

explanation.surface: Someone still arrives, though thoroughly bewildered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn up' reads as arrive, but here it means turn upside down: INVERT without V.
explanation.definitionFit: Inert means motionless or lacking the power to move, the adjectival sense of still.

clue.text: Wicked made moral in this?

indicators.note: wicked suggests something twisted or perverted, so the next two words are bent into a new order

blocks.note: the nine letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A play where the villain is reformed by the final act.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: in a stagey Victorian melodrama the wicked are often redeemed or made moral by the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Melodrama is sensational drama with clear villains and heroes, where vice is typically punished or reformed.

clue.text: Large number upset after US detective produces weapon

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, and in a down entry that turns the word bottom to top

blocks.note: a PI, private investigator, is an American private eye
lots means a large number

explanation.surface: A private eye produces a gun after a crowd gets agitated.
explanation.definitionFit: A pistol is a small firearm held in one hand, so a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Single line by individual

blocks.note: L is the abbreviation for line
one individual is one

explanation.surface: A single row written by one person.
explanation.definitionFit: Lone means solitary or only one, matching the adjective single.

clue.text: Garden worker adopting couple of articles separately as protection from sun?

indicators.note: to adopt is to take into one's family, so the worker takes the articles inside
separately says the pair are not inserted together but at two different points

blocks.note: a hedger trims and lays hedges
two of the indefinite article A, placed separately

explanation.surface: A gardener puts on a couple of items to keep the sun off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Separately' says the two A's go in at different points rather than together. The question mark admits that a hat is only one example of headgear.
explanation.definitionFit: A sun hat is one example of headgear, which covers and shields the head.

clue.text: Incident is occurring in recording poem

indicators.note: something occurring in a place is found inside it, so the word sits within the recording

blocks.note: taken as written
an EP is an extended-play record
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: Something happens while a poem is being recorded.
explanation.definitionFit: An episode is a single event or occurrence in a sequence, so an incident.

clue.text: Miser’s personality recalled after vicious creatures returned

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the creatures are read in the other direction
recalled means called back, so this word is also read backwards

blocks.note: orcs are the brutal monsters of Tolkien
the ego is the self, one's personality

explanation.surface: A miser's true nature comes back after some nasty beasts are sent home.
explanation.definitionFit: Ebenezer Scrooge, Dickens's tight-fisted character, gave his name to any mean, stingy person.

clue.text: A small amount that’s penned about part of tyre

indicators.note: something penned is shut in like an animal in a pen, so the small amount encloses the next word

blocks.note: a tad is a little bit
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Just a few words are written about one bit of a car tyre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penned' looks like written, but here it means enclosed, as in a pen.
explanation.definitionFit: The tread is the patterned outer surface of a tyre that grips the road.

clue.text: Delighted song No. 1 in Estonia, in conclusion

indicators.note: number one means the first, so only the opening letter of the country is used
in places the preceding letters inside the next word, which supplies the outer shell

blocks.note: a chant is a simple sung melody
the first letter of Estonia
the end is the conclusion

explanation.surface: A hit song in Estonia pleased everyone at the finale.
explanation.definitionFit: Enchanted means charmed and filled with delight, so delighted.

clue.text: French are looking less well, slipping back in this?

definitions.text: French are looking less well, slipping back in this?

indicators.note: slipping back means moving backwards, so the preceding letters are read in reverse

blocks.note: es is the French for (you) are
someone unwell looks paler

explanation.surface: A French patient grows paler, sliding back into illness.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is also the definition: in a relapse, someone recovering grows paler again and slips back.
explanation.definitionFit: A relapse is a deterioration after improvement, the return of an illness someone had seemed to recover from.

clue.text: Gentle touch on posterior? Punched by female, a pioneering spirit

indicators.note: a punch makes a hole and drives in, so the female letter is forced inside the posterior

blocks.note: a pat is a light touch with the hand
hinder is an adjective meaning rear or posterior
F is the abbreviation for female

explanation.surface: A tap on the backside followed by a woman's punch shows real spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Posterior' looks like a noun for the backside, but it gives the adjective HINDER, meaning rear.
explanation.definitionFit: A pathfinder is someone who finds new routes, an explorer or trailblazer with a pioneering spirit.

clue.text: Worker missing high point in stage work

indicators.note: missing means lacking, so those letters are absent from the worker

blocks.note: an operator works a machine
a tor is a rocky hilltop, as on Dartmoor in south-west England

explanation.surface: An employee is absent at the climax of a theatre show.
explanation.definitionFit: An opera is a dramatic work set to music and performed on stage.

clue.text: Well-adapted, efficient, and thus pithy? Not initially

indicators.note: not initially means without its opening, so the first letter of the word is dropped

blocks.note: ergo is Latin for therefore or thus
gnomic means expressed in short, pithy maxims

explanation.surface: Something efficient and well designed may therefore be concise too.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergonomic design fits the user's body and work, making a tool comfortable and efficient to use.

clue.text: On leaving, marks time?

indicators.note: leaving means departing, so those letters go out of the following word

blocks.note: taken as written
honours are marks of distinction or respect

explanation.surface: Someone marking time before departing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Marks time' looks like a phrase about waiting, but 'time' is the definition, and the question mark admits hours are just a measure of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Hours are units of time, and the word also means a period or stretch of time generally.

clue.text: Dampen sound of activity? I’d provided way, ultimately

indicators.note: ultimately means at the end, so only the last letter of way is kept

blocks.note: a hum is the busy sound of activity, as in a hive
taken as written, without the apostrophe
provided can mean if, on condition that
the last letter of way

explanation.surface: Someone wants to deaden the noise of a busy place, if only there were a way.
explanation.definitionFit: To humidify is to add moisture to the air, making it damper.

clue.text: Subsequently less sensible, losing head

indicators.note: losing its head means the word's first letter is cut off

blocks.note: dafter means sillier, less sensible

explanation.surface: Afterwards someone grew foolish, perhaps losing their head.
explanation.definitionFit: After used as an adverb means later or afterwards, the same as subsequently.

clue.text: Suggest liqueur is lacking a bit of excitement

indicators.note: lacking means without, so the liqueur goes without that letter
a bit of a word is just a small piece, here its opening letter

blocks.note: advocaat is a Dutch egg-and-brandy liqueur
taken as written
the first letter of excitement

explanation.surface: Someone hints that the after-dinner drink is a bit dull.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'a' in the clue is not part of 'a bit of' but the letter removed; 'a bit of' then takes one letter of excitement.
explanation.definitionFit: To advocate a course is to recommend or propose it publicly, so to suggest it.

clue.text: Successful student receiving new piano

indicators.note: receiving means taking in, so the student holds the next letter inside

blocks.note: a grad is a graduate, a student who has passed
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A graduate is rewarded with a brand-new piano.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand is short for a grand piano, the large concert instrument with a horizontal frame.

clue.text: Nuts about Beethoven’s Third, beginning to rave over conductor

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the nuts go around the next letter
the third means the letter in third place of the composer's name
the beginning of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: mast is the fallen nuts of beech and oak trees
the third letter of Beethoven
the first letter of rave
O is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: Fans mad about Beethoven's Third Symphony cheer the conductor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nuts about' reads as crazy about, but Nuts is a noun, beech MAST, and 'Beethoven's Third' is a letter, not the Eroica symphony.
explanation.definitionFit: Maestro is the respectful title for a distinguished musician, especially an orchestral conductor.

clue.text: Unclear change that’s reduced offer

indicators.note: reduced means cut down, so the word loses its last letter

blocks.note: to turn is to change, as milk turns
a bid is an offer, as at auction

explanation.surface: A murky alteration to a price that has been lowered.
explanation.definitionFit: Turbid means cloudy or muddy, as of water, and figuratively confused or obscure.

clue.text: No afternoon exam could be unethical

blocks.note: not the afternoon but the morning, a.m.
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: Skipping an afternoon test might be seen as wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No afternoon' means the time before noon, AM, not an absence of an afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: Amoral means without moral standards, and it is often used loosely for unprincipled or unethical.

clue.text: What coiner produces — good simoleon in counterfeit form

indicators.note: counterfeit means forged, so the letters are worked into a fake new shape

blocks.note: G is the abbreviation for good
taken as written; a simoleon is American slang for a dollar

explanation.surface: A forger turns out a fake dollar.
explanation.walkthrough: A coiner sounds like a forger of money, but here it is someone who coins new words.
explanation.definitionFit: A neologism is a newly invented word or expression, the thing a word-coiner creates.

clue.text: Soldiers had an impact in area of operations

blocks.note: OR, other ranks, are soldiers who are not officers
bit, past tense of bite, as in a policy that bit

explanation.surface: Troops made their presence felt in the war zone.
explanation.definitionFit: An orbit is a sphere of activity or influence, the range within which someone operates.

clue.text: Party — our group — beginning to resist payment for union

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, so only that is kept

blocks.note: a do is a party or celebration
we is the pronoun for our group
the first letter of resist

explanation.surface: A political party and its members begin to resist paying union dues.
explanation.walkthrough: Union means marriage here, not a trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: A dower was the property or money given for a marriage, such as a widow's share or a dowry.

clue.text: Greedy person — upset of course

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, which in a down entry turns the word bottom to top

blocks.note: flow means course, as of a river

explanation.surface: A glutton is unhappy, naturally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of course' reads as naturally, but 'of' is a link and 'course' is the stream that flips.
explanation.definitionFit: A wolf is a voracious eater, someone who wolfs food down; the animal stands for greed.

clue.text: Liquid carrier’s first thing needed for big run

indicators.note: the first thing of a word is its opening letter

blocks.note: the first letter of big
a ladder is a run in tights or stockings

explanation.surface: A runner needs a water bottle before a long race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Run' suggests jogging, but a ladder is the British word for a run of broken threads in tights.
explanation.definitionFit: The bladder is the bodily organ that holds urine, and also any inflatable bag for liquid or air.

clue.text: Film director joined ranks, heading for immortality

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its first letter

blocks.note: soldiers fell in when they joined the ranks on parade
the first letter of immortality

explanation.surface: A filmmaker joined the ranks of the greats, bound for lasting fame.
explanation.definitionFit: Federico Fellini was the Italian director of La Dolce Vita and 8½.

clue.text: Opening in chess later had revised place for bishop

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter
revised means altered, so the following letters are reordered

blocks.note: the first letter of chess
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A chess opening later changed the square where a bishop stands.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess setting makes bishop look like the piece; it is the clergyman, whose seat is a cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathedral is the principal church of a diocese, containing the bishop's throne.
